verdict.rationale: Check documents an embeddable Onboard Component that collects bank account information, sets up withholdings (W-4-equivalent), and handles tax-form signing, so self-serve onboarding covers the bank and W-4 parts of the story. Nothing in the evidence mentions I-9 collection or a way for an ops user to send a new hire an onboarding invite or link before day one; the Component is embedded in the partner's own app. Missing for 10: I-9 collection, an ops-initiated send/invite flow for new hires, pre-start-date timing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send a new hire a self-serve onboarding flow that collects W-4, I-9, and bank details before day one

citations.quote: leverage the Onboard Component to collect bank account information, set up withholdings, sign tax forms, and more.
